title: Problem
问题
html:
Summary hallucination detectors are often tested on a narrow set of older models or easy examples, so good offline scores can conceal failures on modern, abstractive summaries. Evaluation also needs to distinguish unsupported content from borderline inferences that readers may find acceptable.

FaithBench collects difficult passage-summary pairs from ten current models across eight families, then has experts label unsupported spans and their evidence. It evaluates both which models hallucinate on these cases and whether automatic detectors recognize the errors.

摘要幻觉检测器常在少量旧模型或容易样本上测试，较高离线分数会掩盖它们面对现代抽象式摘要时的失效。评测还要区分无依据内容与读者可能接受的边界推断。

本文从八个模型家族的十个模型收集困难的原文—摘要对，由专家标注无依据片段及证据；它同时衡量模型在这些案例中的幻觉，以及自动检测器能否识别错误。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: FaithBench evaluates faithfulness to a supplied passage, not whether a summary agrees with outside world knowledge: a true statement can still be a hallucination if the source does not support it. It starts from Vectara’s summary leaderboard and holds the source passage fixed while comparing summaries from 10 modern models in 8 families. Instead of spending expert effort on obvious errors, it selects passage-model groups where five popular detectors, including GPT-as-a-judge, disagree most. Eleven annotators then mark suspect summary spans, link them to supporting or contradicting passage spans when possible, and record an explanation. The taxonomy preserves ambiguity rather than forcing a binary label: summaries can be consistent, clearly unsupported but benign, questionable, or unwanted; unwanted errors are intrinsic when contradicted by the passage and extrinsic when neither supported nor factually defensible. Thus the benchmark evaluates both how models hallucinate and whether detectors can recognize difficult, nuanced cases.

FaithBench 评估的是摘要是否忠于给定原文，而非是否符合外部世界知识：一句话即使客观上是真的，只要原文没有支持它，仍可算幻觉。它基于 Vectara 摘要排行榜，让同一篇原文对应 10 个现代模型、8 个家族的摘要，从而可控制原文差异来比较模型。作者不把人工时间花在显而易见的错误上，而是挑选五个主流检测器——包括 GPT 裁判——最不一致的困难样本。11 名标注者在摘要中圈出可疑片段，尽可能链接原文中支持或反驳的片段，并写下理由。标签也不强行二分：可分为一致、虽不受原文支持但可接受的良性、存在争议的可疑，以及不受欢迎的幻觉；后者再分为被原文明示反驳的内在型和既无原文支持、也无事实依据的外在型。因此它同时检验模型如何产生幻觉，以及检测器能否识别这类边界困难的错误。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Start from Vectara Hallucination Leaderboard passage-summary pairs, whose sources include NLI, fact-checking, and summarization data.
  2. Select ten models from eight families; group their ten summaries by shared source passage.
  3. Run True-NLI, TrueTeacher, HHEM-2.1-Open, GPT-4o, and GPT-3.5-Turbo detectors; retain the 115 groups with at least seven detector-disagreement cases.
  4. After a 30-sample pilot and source cleanup, 11 experts annotate spans, labels, notes, and supporting or contradicting passage spans in two rounds.
  5. Remove noisy sources, producing 660 samples from 66 passages; report human agreement, model hallucination rates, and detector balanced accuracy/macro-F1.

Reproduction needs the source snapshot, model outputs, detector versions/prompts, annotation instructions, and label-pooling rule.

1. 从 Vectara 幻觉排行榜的原文—摘要对开始，原文来自自然语言推断、事实核查和摘要数据。
  2. 选八个家族的十个模型，按同一原文把十份摘要分组。
  3. 运行五种检测器，保留至少七份摘要出现检测器分歧的 115 组。
  4. 经 30 例试标和原文清洗后，11 名专家分两轮标注片段、类别、理由及支持或矛盾证据。
  5. 去除噪声原文后得到 66 段原文的 660 例，并报告人工一致性、模型幻觉率和检测器分数。

复现需固定来源快照、模型输出、检测器版本和提示词、标注说明及标签汇总规则。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Claim: popular detectors struggle on the ambiguity they are used to score. Setting: 660 expert-annotated hard summaries from 66 passages; a sample counts as hallucinated when unwanted or questionable. Result: the best reported detector, MiniCheck-Deberta-L, reached 54.95% balanced accuracy and 54.90% macro-F1; GPT-4o had the lowest unwanted-hallucination rate at 39.34% among the tested models. Boundary: the set is deliberately selected for detector disagreement, so neither detector scores nor model rankings estimate average performance on all summaries.
主张：常用检测器会在它们负责评分的模糊案例上失效。设置：66 段原文的 660 份专家标注困难摘要；不良或可疑即计为幻觉。结果：最佳检测器 MiniCheck-Deberta-L 的平衡准确率为 54.95%，宏平均 F1 为 54.90%；在受测模型中，GPT-4o 的不良幻觉率最低，为 39.34%。边界：数据刻意挑选检测器分歧样本，检测器分数和模型排名都不能代表全部摘要的平均表现。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Most hallucination benchmarks emphasize a binary label, aggregate summary score, or a limited model set. FaithBench deliberately samples the detector-disagreement region, adds gray-area labels, and links disputed summary spans to passage evidence. This makes it a calibration set for difficult faithfulness judgments, not a population-representative leaderboard.
多数幻觉基准强调二元标签、摘要总分或少量模型。FaithBench 故意抽取检测器分歧区，加入灰色标签，并把争议摘要片段连到原文证据。它适合作为困难忠实性判断的校准集，而不是代表总体分布的排行榜。

title: Limitations
局限
html: FaithBench covers source-grounded summarization, not general QA, long-context reasoning, or real production RAG. Its hard-case sampling changes the class distribution and makes model-size or global ranking conclusions fragile. Experts still disagree substantially on benign and questionable cases, and evidence links assist judgment rather than create objective truth.
FaithBench 只覆盖有原文依据的摘要，不代表通用问答、长上下文推理或真实生产环境的检索增强生成。困难样本抽样改变了类别分布，使模型规模和总体排名结论不稳。专家对良性、可疑两类仍有明显分歧，证据链接只能辅助判断，不能制造客观真值。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use it to stress-test a summary-faithfulness detector or to design evidence-linked human review. Give the detector a passage and summary, compare its decision with the span labels and rationales, then inspect error types rather than only aggregate accuracy. Do not use it alone to claim a detector works on ordinary summaries or other generation tasks.
可用它压力测试摘要忠实性检测器，或设计带证据链接的人工复核：输入原文与摘要，对照片段标签和理由，再检查错误类型而非只看总准确率。不能仅据此宣称检测器适用于普通摘要或其他生成任务。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Treat faithfulness and world factuality as separate targets.
  2. Preserve the four-way label, not only a binary collapse.
  3. Inspect linked evidence for every disputed span.
  4. Report detector results separately on hard and representative data.
  5. Record model output and detector-prompt versions.

1. 将忠实性与世界事实性分开评估。
  2. 保留四类标签，不只压缩成二元标签。
  3. 检查每个争议片段的链接证据。
  4. 分别报告困难样本和代表性样本的检测结果。
  5. 记录模型输出与检测器提示词版本。
